name: Nate Su-ru-ya
source:
Hometown: Midvan
Occupation: Thief
Weapon: Bow

A werewolf who lives in a forest close to Midvan called the Vorfshantse.
His outer appearance is like a small and slender boy, but in reality he is the oldest member of the party.
